newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says it shot at U.S. planes, none hit - TV.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says it shot at U.S. planes, none hit - TV.

text.p: Iraq said on Saturday it fired surface-to-air missiles against U.S. warplanes policing the no-fly zones in northern and southern Iraq but added that no planes were shot down.

"Iraqi air defence men have confronted the hostile (American) aircraft by firing surface-to-air missiles," state television said quoting a defence ministry spokesman. It did not say when the incident took place.
